notes.title: 1/4 New update.
notes.content:
You can build your own village in the game now!
Also, I added a sandbox map for testing.

New system : 
Village System: 
Find a nice location and build a well for your village.
And hire some villagers to help you run your village.
Also, catch some monster to defend it.

Sandbox World:
I am trying to make a randomly generated sandbox world the main world for multiplayer.
I released a simple world for players to try it out.

Small update:
Players can use [E] to call or stop your mount or creature.


Next Version, I will focus on Improve multiplayer connections and create a playable sandbox world.
I hope players can invite their friends to develop the same world.
Also, I will add all monster types to the dungeon maker.

And the current game file is a bit too large, I will try to compress the game.

notes.title: Blade of Arean : PVP and Dungeon Maker!
notes.content:
Currently, At the demo game, we have a few game modes for players.
1. 1v1 duel
2. 8 players brawl
2. Dungeon Design

Duel game mode
Have a fair competition with other players.
All Equipment will start at LV1, then it will auto-upgrade at each round.

Brawl game mode
The equipment will be randomly assigned to the treasure chest on an island.
You can try to use other player weapons or equipment to win the battle.

Dungeon maker
You can design your own dungeon and place monsters,
Or design a platform game for other players.
